final_message:
Yen receipts now render correctly (`Paid ¥500 by card`), and all 18 tests pass.

The cause was the shared `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divides every amount by 100, so 500 yen came out as `¥5.00`. That file is outside `src/payments`, so I left it alone.

I fixed it in `src/payments/receipt.js` instead. For JPY, the receipt now prints the amount as whole yen. Other currencies still go through `formatMoney`.

If you want the fix at the source, the owners of `src/utils/money.js` could make `formatMoney` handle zero-decimal currencies. Invoices, cart and admin probably have the same yen bug. Once that lands, the JPY special case in `receipt.js` can be removed.
